project.name: bkit
project.summary: Installs a shared engineering process into coding assistants and runs the commands that support designing, building, checking and shipping changes. This is a command-line tool and instruction package, with no application server or database.

nodes.label: Command-line engine
nodes.summary: Runs installation, workflow commands and shared record handling.

nodes.label: Workflow commands
nodes.summary: Coordinates branches, reviews, test runs, progress and shipping.

nodes.label: Install and upgrade
nodes.summary: Writes the selected assistant setup while preserving project-owned settings.

nodes.label: Assistant adapters
nodes.summary: Converts shared instructions and model choices into each assistant's format.

nodes.label: Setup checks
nodes.summary: Detects missing prerequisites and checks the resulting installation.

nodes.label: Progress records
nodes.summary: Reads, validates and combines workflow progress, findings and measurements.

nodes.label: Shared foundations
nodes.summary: Keeps package settings, paths, process calls and common formats consistent.

nodes.label: Assistant safety hooks
nodes.summary: Supplies the reusable checks that assistants run around edits and shell commands.

nodes.label: Project starter tools
nodes.summary: Provides copy-and-own scripts for testing, cloud setup, secrets and repository maintenance.

nodes.label: Repository maintenance
nodes.summary: Maintains this repository's checks, capability diagrams and development measurements.

nodes.label: Capability ownership
nodes.summary: Builds diagrams and checks for competing implementations or callers bypassing their owner.

nodes.label: Workflow measurements
nodes.summary: Collects local workflow evidence and produces cross-project measurements.

nodes.label: Test and quality runners
nodes.summary: Runs the repository checks and reports their outcomes.

nodes.label: Tests and experiments
nodes.summary: Checks engine behavior, shipped instructions, hooks and project templates.

nodes.label: Engine tests
nodes.summary: Checks installation, workflow commands and the common engine contracts.

nodes.label: Payload audits
nodes.summary: Checks that shipped instructions, hooks and templates preserve their required contracts.

nodes.label: External tools and services
nodes.summary: Connects workflows to repository hosting, issue trackers and model providers.

nodes.label: GitHub
nodes.summary: Hosts source changes, pull requests, issues and automated checks.

nodes.label: Optional issue trackers
nodes.summary: Stores work items in Linear or Jira when the project selects them.
